characters.summary: Thaal Sinestro bonded with the fear entity Parallax, gaining vastly amplified cosmic reality-warping and fear-manipulation abilities. He fights using overwhelming fear constructs, energy projection, and corruption of his opponents' minds.
limitations: Vulnerable to combined willpower of multiple Green Lanterns
characters.formDifferences: Adds the power of the Parallax entity to Sinestro's baseline yellow power ring, significantly increasing his raw power, warping reality, and granting dominion over fear.

sources.supports: Basic background, affiliation with Parallax entity, and history as Green Lantern and leader of the Sinestro Corps.
Parallax possession details, yellow light mastery, and reality manipulation feats.

feats.claim: Imprisoned the Guardians of the Universe using fear constructs

notableResults.note: Hal Jordan overcame Parallax with combined corps energies.

campaignTags.claim: Flight powered by the yellow ring and fear entity
Inducing intense terror and psychological manipulation of enemies using fear

unknowns: Exact limits of reality-warping while bonded to Parallax.

characters.summary: Thaal Sinestro briefly wielded the White Lantern ring, granting him mastery over life itself and the ability to create complex constructs of light without needing fear or willpower alone. He fights by generating life-infused energy constructs and healing injuries.
weaknesses: Emotional instability disrupts white light connection
limitations: White Lantern rings have limited charge and select their bearers based on life force compatibility
characters.formDifferences: Replaces Sinestro's standard yellow ring with the White Lantern ring, changing his energy source from fear to the power of life.

sources.supports: White Lantern ring wielding history during the New 52 era.
White Lantern ring usage, creation of life constructs, and regeneration feats.

feats.claim: Created life and manipulated energy on a cosmic scale using the White Lantern ring

notableResults.note: Assisted by other ring-wielders to defeat Volthoom.

conditional.ability: Life manipulation and universal construct generation

campaignTags.claim: Flight enabled by the White Lantern ring
Restoring life and healing mortal wounds using white light

unknowns: Duration of the White Lantern ring's bond before rejecting the user.

characters.summary: Solomon Grundy is a massive, undead powerhouse endowed with extreme superhuman strength, durability, and a healing factor. He fights with brute physical force, punching, throwing debris, and overwhelming opponents through sheer resilience.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to fire and magical attacks
limitations: Low intelligence makes him susceptible to trickery
Power levels fluctuate depending on how he is resurrected

sources.supports: Origin as a resurrected corpse, superhuman strength, durability, and weaknesses.
Feats of fighting Superman and Justice League members.

feats.claim: Stalemated Superman in direct physical combat temporarily

notableResults.note: Overpowered once Superman utilized concentrated tactical attacks.

campaignTags.claim: Massive towering stature and enormous physical mass
Resurrects and heals from lethal trauma upon returning to Slaughter Swamp

unknowns: Exact limits of his strength variance across different resurrections.

characters.summary: Princess Koriand'r of Tamaran absorbs ultraviolet radiation to fuel her superhuman abilities. She fights using ultraviolet energy blasts (starbolts), enhanced agility, and hand-to-hand combat training.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to absorption or deprivation of ultraviolet radiation
limitations: Depleted of powers if kept in total darkness for extended periods

sources.supports: Tamaranian physiology, ultraviolet absorption, starbolts, and flight.
Combat feats, Teen Titans leadership, and energy projection capabilities.

feats.claim: Fired starbolts capable of staggering heavy armored opponents and damaging starships

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill before forming an alliance.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to fly at supersonic speeds through stellar energy absorption

unknowns: Exact maximum speed in deep space.

characters.summary: Virgil Hawkins possesses electromagnetic powers granted by a Quantum-juice explosion. He fights by manipulating magnetic fields, generating high-voltage electrical discharges, and riding a metallic disc for flight.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to grounded environments or rubber insulation
limitations: Requires access to electromagnetic fields or electricity to maintain high-end output

sources.supports: Electromagnetism powers, disc flight, and origin.
Detailed electrical generation and electromagnetic shielding feats.

feats.claim: Short-circuited city-wide power grids and disabled advanced tech simultaneously

notableResults.note: Defeated Holocaust by flooding him with high-voltage feedback.

conditional.dependsOn: Having a metallic surface or disc to ride on

campaignTags.claim: Generation and manipulation of high-voltage electricity
Direct control over electrical currents and electronic devices
Rides a metallic saucer propelled by electromagnetic fields

unknowns: Upper limit of electricity output without risking self-harm.

characters.summary: Conner Kent is a human-Kryptonian hybrid clone who possesses tactile telekinesis, superhuman strength, durability, and heat vision. He fights with a combination of raw physical brawn and telekinetic manipulation of objects.
limitations: Tactile telekinesis requires physical contact with objects to manipulate them

sources.supports: Hybrid clone origins, tactile telekinesis, and heat vision.
Combat encounters with Teen Titans and Superman-level powers.

feats.claim: Disassembled a complex machine instantly using tactile telekinesis

notableResults.note: Overpowered by the pre-Crisis Superboy-Prime in a brutal clash.

campaignTags.claim: Tactile telekinesis allowing object manipulation and simulated invulnerability

unknowns: Exact genetic stability limits under extreme stress.

characters.summary: Kara Zor-El is a Kryptonian whose cells absorb yellow sun radiation, granting her immense physical power, flight, speed, and heat vision. She fights with unbridled brute force and direct energy projection.
limitations: Power depletes if exposed to red sunlight or depleted of yellow solar energy

sources.supports: Kryptonian physiology, solar radiation absorption, and powers.
Feats of strength against powerhouses and combat history.

feats.claim: Smashed through tectonic plates during a battle with world-class threats

campaignTags.claim: Innate flight powered by yellow sun radiation absorption

unknowns: Emotional control issues affecting her combat restraint.

characters.summary: Kara Zor-El, consumed by rage and grief after the destruction of Krypton, is recruited into the Red Lantern Corps. She fights with a mix of Kryptonian physiology and corrosive napalm-like red plasma vomit and rage constructs.
weaknesses: Removal of the Red Lantern ring causes rapid death for standard users (though mitigated by Kryptonian physiology)
limitations: Prone to berserker rages that impair tactical thinking
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard yellow-sun energized state with a Red Lantern ring, granting acidic plasma projection and fueling her attacks with pure rage.

sources.supports: New 52 Red Lantern storyline context.
Red Lantern ring acquisition, plasma vomit, and rage combat feats.

feats.claim: OBLITERATED a starship fleet using unbridled red plasma blasts in space

notableResults.note: Defeated Atrocitus for control over a faction of Red Lanterns.

conditional.ability: Corrosive red plasma projection and rage-enhanced durability

campaignTags.claim: Flight powered by the Red Lantern ring combined with Kryptonian ability

unknowns: Long-term psychological toll of sustained Red Lantern ring usage.

characters.summary: Kal-El is the quintessential Kryptonian powerhouse, drawing immense strength, speed, durability, and senses from yellow solar radiation. He fights using devastating physical blows, heat vision, super-breath, and high-speed maneuvers.

mechanisms: Rapid cellular healing under yellow sun

limitations: Vulnerable to kryptonite radiation and magic
Depleted of powers under red suns

sources.supports: Classic Kryptonian origin, solar radiation absorption, and powers.
Feats of lifting massive weights, surviving planetary-level blasts.

feats.claim: Pushed a planet-sized object out of orbit

notableResults.note: Both perished in mutual combat exhaustion.

campaignTags.claim: Innate flight powered by yellow sun energy absorption

unknowns: Absolute ceiling of physical strength under extreme solar dipping.

characters.summary: An older, more experienced Superman from a dystopian future who has absorbed decades of unfiltered solar radiation. He fights with unmatched efficiency, brutal raw power, and absolute command over his Kryptonian abilities.

mechanisms: Extreme invulnerability due to heightened solar absorption

weaknesses: Magical or high-intensity radiation like Gold Kryptonite
limitations: Moral restraint against killing, though pushed to extremes in this timeline
characters.formDifferences: Older, grayer appearance with significantly higher resilience to standard Green Kryptonite due to decades of soaking up yellow sunlight.

sources.supports: Older Superman background, enhanced solar absorption, and story context.
Immunity to green kryptonite due to solar saturation, combat feats.

feats.claim: Survived a point-blank nuclear explosion with minimal injury due to high solar saturation

notableResults.note: Defeated Shazam after weathering magical lightning strikes.

campaignTags.claim: Innate flight powered by years of accumulated yellow solar energy

unknowns: Exact limits of his immunity to Green Kryptonite.
